prompt: Use case: historical documentary still life. No visible faces, no detailed coin portraits, no hands. Photorealistic archaeological reconstruction, restrained golden side light, simple readable shapes, vertical portrait composition with large dark negative space above for captions. No text, no watermark, no modern currency, no oversized coins, no Roman imagery.
